name: Bandolier
description: A bandolier expands the number of Belt slots a bug has access to by +1 for every 50 spent on the bandolier.

name: Fancy Clothes
description: The wearer's Cute is increased by 0.5.

name: Thirsty Straw
description: Portable pump resembling a proboscis. Pumps liquids into a container or expels them as a spray. When used with a flask, flask's contents affect a Short Cone instead of being thrown; Terrain+ flasks affect a Large Cone instead.

name: 1 square of Thread
description: Ordinary thread has a Load cap of 5 and will break if it exceeds its Load.

name: 1 square of Silk
description: Spider silk is stronger than ordinary thread, capable of handling heavier loads without breaking. Load cap 10.

name: 1 square of Flaskfuse
description: A bit of rope soaked in greaseslime. When lit, it burns away rapidly and causes the flask it is attached to to burst.

name: Matchstick
description: 0 quality weapon with 1 base damage; can be lit to cast light in range 4. Deals 1 environmental fire damage on hit when lit. Burns out at the end of the scene and cannot be reused.

name: Sheet of Vespine Paper
description: Durable paper that is hard to wreck.

name: Herbal Balm
description: When applied during a rest, enhances natural healing; increases Hearts recovered that rest by 1.

name: Pollen-treated Bandages
description: When applied during a rest, enhance natural healing; increases Hearts recovered that rest by 2.

name: Scrap Patch
description: When applied to armor outside combat, restores 1 Durability.

name: Armor Patch
description: When applied to armor outside combat, restores 2 Durability.

name: Repair Wax
description: Can be applied to a piece of equipment at any time for 1 Stamina. Restores 2 Durability/Deterioration immediately. Can also be applied to a bug's Shell to restore up to 2 lost Shell.

name: Chunk of Shellwood
description: A piece of tough wood, used to make shields, armor, furniture, or buildings.

name: Chunk of Ore
description: Metal ore used to craft various weapons and tools.

name: Chunk of Pale Ore
description: A strong and incredibly rare metal ore. Can be used to upgrade weapons.
